for_any_chosen_head: if at least two distinct class words occur, at least one differs from chosen head; if all equal, no chosen head has a differing feature
equivalent_rule: distinct_classes==1 and mentions>=2 and latest_quality==chol => ACCEPT
consequence: No choice of claimed head among prefix class mentions changes output. More examples with this same rule alone cannot identify direction.
limits: Only fixed S10 any-different rule and shared quality binding; role-sensitive rules or independently read relational markers are different tests.
